label: configurator • create an agent from a named built-in template
query: Make me an agent from the Cloud Agent template and call it "Scout".
notes: Agent templates contract: when the user names a template, the Configurator creates the agent from it — `osaurus_config` plan/apply with `template` set to the built-in Cloud Agent and the new name in `overrides` (or as agent fields in `yaml` beside the template, which the tool reads as overrides) — instead of hand-writing an `agents:` entry that would drop the template's model, tools and subagent settings. Under the isolated config root the only templates are the built-ins (Cloud Agent, Local Agent, Sub Agent); Cloud Agent prefers a model that is not installed, so the plan notes the fallback to the default model and the apply still lands.
